items.note: Experiment with 82 participants on a creative task with or without GenAI; outcomes named are intrinsic motivation, domain- and creativity-relevant skills, and self-evaluated performance, which look self-reported, so the full text must show whether any output is rated (else self_report_only).

125 Ghanaian students randomly allocated to ChatGPT or databases and search engines for in-class research-methods tasks; creativity is measured with a Creative Thinking Scale (a questionnaire), not scored on output.

CHI system paper (StoryPrompt) with a mixed-methods evaluation of 40 children comparing AI-assisted storytelling with a storyboard method on rated creativity and richness; same sample as arXiv 2606.27067 (c307); below 50 participants.

Within-subjects experiment with 40 children comparing GenAI-assisted and storyboard storytelling, reporting rated creativity and richness and a narrowing quality gap; same sample as the CHI 2025 StoryPrompt paper (c305); order randomization not stated; below 50.

163 students in inclusive groups did collaborative digital mind-mapping, with and without AI-provided prompts, and Torrance Figural scores rose pre to post; the AI-versus-no-AI comparison is secondary and whether the AI is generative is unclear.

Quasi-experiment (nonequivalent control group) with 50 fifth-graders: ChatGPT structured prompting versus conventional fiction-writing lessons, with a scored pre/post story-writing test; DOI string looks odd (v1i2 for a 9(4) issue), so verify the record.

Abstract not reachable (OpenAlex, Crossref, Semantic Scholar, Europe PMC, publisher page all failed); search notes describe a controlled design experiment with AIGC support versus designer collaboration versus image stimuli, with CPSS novelty and elaboration ratings.

Turn-based co-writing in matched human-human, human-LLM, and LLM-LLM conditions, with computed semantic novelty of turns; the outcome is interactional (who introduces novel material) rather than story-level creativity, and sample size and assignment are not stated.

Between-subjects online experiment (n=149, Indian and US participants) all writing with AI suggestions, varying a values-framing intervention; outcomes are AI reliance and uniqueness of essay text (across_people); no no-AI arm; FAccT 2026 version of arXiv 2605.20512.

Controlled experiment in design education crossing generative AI tool type (text-to-image versus other) with visual stimulus type, on rated design creativity; no no-AI arm; abstract gives no sample size (search notes say 84).
